fields.name: x
fields.coerce: `parseFloat(x) || 0`, so a string such as `"100"` works and a value that is not a number is 0

responses.name: Distance
responses.when: You have a character. The payload is a bare string, not a `LocalizedText`.
responses.summary: The distance in px from your position on the server to the point, as text: `"" + simple_distance(...)`. It has all the digits of the number, for example `"223.60679774997897"`. The map is not compared.
